title: console: the boot screen tells every returning user it is "setting up a new environment" through three staged steps, and the cloud welcome page takes ~9 s warm / ~20 s cold to show content while still pulling per-icon and Studio-inspector chunks
body:
Item 4 of objectstack-ai/cloud#2772. Filed from the cloud maintainer's session with the maintainer's agreement on 2026-10-12 (「同意」). ⛔ Not a claim.

## Source

2026-10-12 staging walk-through of the cloud console: `cloud.objectos.app`, org 「2531 hotcrm 验收」, owner account; cloud `63ea887f`, objectui pin `d758f2f2`. The pin already contains objectui#11798's merge `5d691334`.

## What the user sees

Every full page load of the cloud console passes through the boot screen: product name, 「正在初始化应用程序…」, three staged steps (连接数据源 / 加载配置 / 准备工作区) and the line 「初始化新环境可能需要几秒钟。」 (en "Setting up a new environment can take a few moments."). This is not a new environment, the steps are not real, and on the first cold load the copy rendered in English before the locale arrived.

![boot screen](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/blob/fdd422db1e94a4190958fb770bd21ad1ae520e63/01-loading-screen.jpg?raw=true)

Measured on the cloud welcome page, warm tab (`performance.now()` since navigation start, polled until `main` exists):

| metric | value |
|---|---|
| `main` appears | 8 867 ms |
| DOMContentLoaded / load event | 951 ms |
| resource entries at that moment | 250 |
| network entries the pane had buffered | 499+ |
| cold load (staging is no longer always-on, cloud#2766) | about 20 s |

The last requests before content are dozens of one-icon `vendor-icon-*.js` chunks and Studio inspector chunks (`HookDefaultInspector`, `ReportDefaultInspector`, `InterfaceListPage`, `default-inspector-registry`) on a page that is not Studio. `sys_user_preference` is read three times per load.

## Mechanism (to confirm)

- The boot screen and its copy are the console shell's (objectui#2628 introduced the screen; the strings are the "Initializing application…" family in `packages/i18n`).
- objectui#11798 moved the Studio builder and chart engine off the eager path. The chunks above are still reached from a plain page route, presumably through the icon registry and the inspector registry, so the eager-closure budget does not see them. objectui#11762 (on hold) is about the budget line, not this.

## Fix direction (recommended)

1. Boot screen: product name plus one honest line (「正在打开你的控制台…」 / "Opening your console…"), no staged steps, no "new environment". Until the locale loads, show a neutral string, not English.
2. Find what pulls the inspector chunks and the per-icon chunks on `/_console/apps/*/page/*` and split them by route; the icons the shell itself uses go in one chunk.
3. One `sys_user_preference` read per load (share the query).

## Acceptance

1. Boot screen screenshots in zh-CN and en: one line, no steps, no "new environment"; the first cold load on a zh-CN browser is not English.
2. Welcome page on staging, warm: `main` within 3 s, under 100 requests before content, no `*Inspector*` / `InterfaceListPage` chunk on a non-Studio route (network log attached).
3. `sys_user_preference` requested once per load.

## Related

objectui#11798 · objectui#11762 · objectui#2628 · objectui#11678 · objectstack-ai/cloud#2768 (the home page this screen fronts) · objectstack-ai/cloud#2766
